rules.screenshot_region: verdict text under the Bounced badge

reasons: The times ("Nov 15, 2026, 2:04 AM") show no time zone, which breaks R-TIME-1. The delivery's status badge says "Bounced", an event word, instead of one of the five status words such as Failed, which breaks R-STATUS-1. The page also uses "Deliveries" and "Mailable" instead of Activity and Mailer, which breaks R-WORDS-1. The verdict sentence tells the reader to open the delivery they are already viewing and gives no real next step, which breaks R-VOICE-1.
